Product Disclaimer: Product packaging may vary.
They say night is darkest before the dawn, but how can the sun rise when the Phyrexian legion blots out our sky? Under this menacing mechanical umbra, we look to the resistance efforts on other worlds for inspiration.

Find the will to keep fighting in these showcase treatments in spectacular Halo Foil from Kamigawa, Ixalan, Tarkir, Zendikar, and New Phyrexia with stunning art by Rorubei, Yeong-Hao Han, Domenico Cava, Jessica Rossier, and JungShan.

Contents:
• 1x Halo Foil Higure, the Still Wind
• 1x Halo Foil Nezahal, Primal Tide
• 1x Halo Foil Dragonlord Kolaghan
• 1x Halo Foil Mina and Denn, Wildborn
• 1x Halo Foil Xantcha, Sleeper Agent
